description: Monthly Consumer Price Index (CPI) for US metropolitan areas, tracking nominal CPI (all items including energy) for each city. Measures changes in prices paid by urban consumers for a basket of goods and services. Data from BLS API series CUUR[AREACODE]SA0, indexed to 1982-84=100. CPI values represent the average price level relative to 1982-84, where 1982-84=100. Higher CPI values indicate higher cost of living relative to the base period. Used to compare cost of living between different US metropolitan areas.
